_comment: Events on arriving in port. See docs/events.md.

tavern_brawl.title: Tavern brawl
tavern_brawl.text: Your men are drinking in a {port} tavern when a crew from a {nation_adj} ship starts calling them names. Chairs are already flying.

choices.result: The {nation_adj} sailors are thrown into the harbour. Your men will drink to this for a year.
choices.fail_result: You win, but someone breaks a bottle over your head.

choices.text: Pay the landlord and drag your men out
choices.result: Your men think you've gone soft.

choices.text: Let the watch sort it out
choices.result: Two of your men spend a week in the gaol, and decide to stay ashore.

press_gang.title: The press gang
press_gang.text: A navy press gang is sweeping the waterfront of {port}, taking any seaman they can catch.

choices.result: No shore leave. The men grumble, but they're safe.
He finds other ships more interesting.

choices.text: Let them take their chances ashore
choices.result: Three don't come back.

pickpocket.title: Light fingers
pickpocket.text: In the crowd on the quay someone brushes past you. Your purse is lighter.

choices.result: You catch him in an alley. He gives it back with interest.
choices.fail_result: He vanishes into the crowd with {amount} gold.

choices.result: A {amount}-gold lesson.

old_shipmate.title: An old shipmate
old_shipmate.text: In a waterfront tavern you run into {friend}, who sailed with you years ago. Down on their luck, but a good seaman still.

choices.result: Like old times.
{friend} swears to pay you back.
You talk of old times until closing.

fortune_teller.title: The fortune teller
fortune_teller.text: An old woman in a doorway offers to read your palm. The crew watching from the tavern are curious what she'll say.

choices.result: 'Gold and glory, Captain, and a long life.' The crew are delighted.
choices.fail_result: 'I see drowning.' The men go pale.

choices.result: She curses you, cheerfully.

harbour_dues.title: Harbour dues
harbour_dues.text: The harbour master of {port} has found new dues to charge: anchorage, lighthouse, the King's health.

choices.result: {fee} gold, receipted.
He gives up and waives the lot.
choices.fail_result: You pay, and he makes a note of your name.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.text: There's fever in {port}. The authorities want every ship to wait in the outer roads for a week.

choices.result: A week of staring at the shore.

choices.text: Come in anyway, and risk the fever
choices.result: Nobody aboard falls ill.
choices.fail_result: Three men catch it and die.

town_fire.title: Fire in the town
town_fire.text: Smoke over {port}: the warehouses along the waterfront are burning.

choices.text: Send your men to fight the fire
choices.result: Your crew save half the waterfront. The governor sends thanks.
Fifteen hogsheads of sugar walk out of a burning warehouse.
It burns for a day. Prices will be wild for a while.

festival.title: Feast day
festival.text: {port} is celebrating a saint's day: processions, music, cheap wine, and every tavern open all night.

choices.text: Give the crew a night ashore
choices.result: A grand night. One man is never seen again.
They watch the fireworks from the rail.

duel_challenge.title: A challenge
duel_challenge.text: A young {nation_adj} gentleman claims you insulted his honour in the tavern last night. He demands satisfaction at dawn.

choices.result: You disarm him in three passes and let him live. Your name goes up in the world.
choices.fail_result: He's better than he looked. You'll carry the scar.

choices.result: He accepts with a sneer.

choices.text: Have your men throw him in the harbour
choices.result: Problem solved.

card_game.title: Cards with a planter
card_game.text: A rich planter invites you to a game of piquet. The stakes are high.

choices.result: You leave {stake} richer and he leaves annoyed.
He shrugs and finds another pigeon.

informant_news.title: A man who knows things
informant_news.text: A clerk from the {port} customs house sidles up. For a price, he'll tell you which ships are loading what, and when they sail.

choices.result: A {nation_adj} merchantman, heavily laden, sailing soon. You'll be waiting.
He tries the next captain.

informant_tip.title: Just as the clerk said
informant_tip.text: A {nation_adj} merchantman, low in the water, exactly where the clerk said she'd be.

choices.result: You come out of the sun.
Not today.

wanted_poster.title: Your face on the wall
wanted_poster.text: A handbill nailed to the tavern door: a crude woodcut of you, and a price on your head.

choices.result: You add it to your collection.

choices.text: Laugh, and correct the spelling of your name
choices.result: The crew roar. The story travels.

customs_search.title: Customs search
customs_search.text: Customs officers come aboard in {port} with a warrant. Someone has told them your hold is full of stolen goods.

choices.result: He signs the report: nothing found.
choices.fail_result: He takes the money and reports you anyway.

choices.text: Bluff: those goods were bought honestly
choices.result: Your paperwork is a masterpiece of invention. They leave.
choices.fail_result: They fine you, and your name goes in a book.

shipwright_offer.title: A shipwright's offer
shipwright_offer.text: A shipwright out of work offers to patch your hull cheaply, using timber he 'found'.

choices.result: Your carpenter watches him like a hawk. Good work, cheap.
choices.fail_result: Green timber, badly fitted. It's already weeping.

choices.result: He shrugs.

passenger_request.title: A passenger
passenger_request.text: A well-dressed {nation_adj} merchant asks for passage to {dest}, and will pay handsomely.

choices.result: He pays half now, half on arrival in {dest}.

choices.text: Take him, and hold him for ransom at sea
choices.result: His family pay well, eventually.
He finds another ship.

passenger_arrives.title: Safe arrival
passenger_arrives.text: Your passenger steps ashore at {dest}, pays the rest, and promises to speak well of you.

choices.result: A profitable little voyage.

deserters_seek_berth.title: Men looking for a ship
deserters_seek_berth.text: Half a dozen hard-looking men want to sign on. They won't say which ship they left, or why.

choices.result: Navy deserters, by the look of them. Good seamen.
You take the three honest-looking ones.
They'll find a ship. They always do.

smuggler_contact.title: A quiet offer
smuggler_contact.text: A man in the shadows offers to sell you {good} for half the market price. No receipts.

choices.result: It's real, and it's stolen.
The governor's men thank you.
He melts back into the dark.

priest_blessing.title: A blessing for the ship
priest_blessing.text: A priest offers to bless the {ship} for a donation to his church.

choices.result: Holy water on the bow. The superstitious hands breathe easier.
He blesses you anyway, rather pointedly.
